lines: "Goodbye, thank you," she shouted at the top of her voice.
Something more important than sorrow.
I wanted to say something to the back that was leaving.
So that warmth and pain would reach in time.
I thought it would keep going just like this.
We were painting our tomorrow.
Calling each other.
The light still.
Though it's burning deep in my chest.
We met amid a raging journey.
We let our hands pass and then part, for the sake of the future.
Whenever a dream is fulfilled, I will think of you.
I wept, wishing to become stronger.
With resolve as my farewell.
I want to be held by nostalgic yearning.
Crying and screaming in a cruel world.
It grows the more we become adults.
I can no longer lose even a single thing.
If I were to be swallowed by sorrow and fall.
I would no longer feel pain, though.
You.
Your wish.
I swore I would protect you to the end.
Oh wow, oh, oh wow
Oh wow, oh, oh wow
It crumbles down with a sound.
The only one.
An irreplaceable world.
I reached out and held a bundle of fierce light.
It shone and vanished for the future.
Going beyond the happiness entrusted and the promises.
Because I move forward without looking back.
Because I face forward and shout.
Lighting a flame in my heart toward a distant future.
